exclusions.source_text: A glomerular filtration rate (GFR) ≥ 60 mL/min/1.73 m\^2

exclusions.threshold: creatinine age-based maximum (e.g. 0.4 mg/dL at 1 month to <6 months)

exclusions.source_text: Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 x upper limit of normal (ULN) for age
Serum glutamate pyruvate transaminase (SGPT) (alanine aminotransferase \[ALT\]) ≤ 135 U/L
Shortening fraction of ≥ 27% by echocardiogram, or ejection fraction of ≥ 50% by radionuclide angiogram

HIV-infected patients on effective anti-retroviral therapy with undetectable viral load within 6 months are eligible as long as they are NOT receiving anti-retroviral agents that are strong inhibitors or inducers of CYP3A4
Administration of prior PPB-directed chemotherapy is an exclusion criterion. Prior treatment for another malignancy is not an exclusion criterion
Female patients who are pregnant since fetal toxicities and teratogenic effects have been noted for several of the study drugs.
Lactating females who plan to breastfeed their infants
